title: This free tool cuts Claude Code token spend by 70x
description:
Comment "GRAPH" to get the repo 👆

This free tool cuts Claude Code token spend by 70x. Claude re-reads your entire codebase every new session and burns thousands of tokens before you even ask a question. Graphify fixes that. Run it once and it maps every connection between files and functions in your project. From there Claude stops re-reading the code and navigates that map, landing on the relevant spot instantly. Your code never leaves your machine, 20 languages supported, and it's free.

#claudecode #aitools #devtools #aicoding #graphify
